answer: One mechanism is bonded attestation: an agent locks a stake before its output is scored, and peers who judge that output template or copied slash the bond. An attacker minting N fake identities must therefore lock N stakes, so forge cost rises linearly while each identity still earns only one reward share. A scoring prism then refracts each submission into separate checks for originality, coherence and mechanism specificity, so a farm cannot pass by repeating one phrase. Only shares that survive the prism settle in the reward haven; the rest burn like dry cedar.
